# UX State-Machine Checklist: Questionnaire Feedback

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature requirements fully specify the questionnaire state machines for confirmatory timing, prompt suppression, surface collision avoidance, session-end cadence, and weekly ISO-week re-prompt behavior.
**Created**: 2026-06-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are confirmatory trigger requirements complete for the named sustained-tense tunable, default duration, active-session precondition, and top-band-only condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011-FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are prompt dwell and signal-drop auto-dismiss requirements complete for the named dwell tunable and lower-band transition conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK003 Are one-prompt-per-session requirements defined for answered, expired, and later-return-to-tense paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are next-session suppression requirements complete after `false_alarm`, including the statement that suppression applies to the next session only? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are confirmatory answer outcomes and Ren handoff state transitions specified for all three answer options? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017-FR-020, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK006 Are surface-collision requirements complete for the transition from mid-session confirmatory prompt to post-session feedback card? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038, Spec §SC-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are weekly cadence requirements complete for first authenticated visit of a new ISO week, first skip, one re-prompt, second skip, and wait-until-next-week behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040-FR-040a, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Are the named tunables for sustained-tense duration and prompt dwell floor clearly identified as adjustable values with v1 defaults? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-013a, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between answered outcomes and signal-drop expiry clear enough to avoid persisting an answered outcome for auto-dismissed prompts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-024, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the definition of "next monitoring session" clear enough for `false_alarm` suppression to avoid repeated or permanent suppression? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is ISO week cadence specified clearly enough to handle week boundaries and repeated visits without relying on local ambiguous language? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040-FR-040a]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the session-end sampling seam requirement clear that v1 defaults to every monitoring session while allowing later frequency reduction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025-FR-025a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are confirmatory timing requirements consistent across clarifications, acceptance scenarios, functional requirements, success criteria, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-013-FR-013a, Spec §SC-001-SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Are weekly re-prompt requirements consistent across acceptance scenarios, edge cases, functional requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-040a, Spec §SC-018]

- [ ] CHK016 Are race conditions between prompt answer, signal-drop auto-dismiss, and session end addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are non-video and Ren conversational trigger exclusions specified clearly enough to prevent unintended questionnaire triggers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Out of Scope]
